_note: Closure-class verdict artifact for the anti-gaming gate (CL-F-002). Written by critique, which is a DIFFERENT phase from the one it grades — forge produced the suite, critique produces this verdict. Nothing here is waived; a waive is Dami-only and none was requested.
note: The forge suite is substantively real and the thesis is sound, but TWO correctness defects reach the engine and ONE reaches the console, so a clean PROCEED would be false. Conditions are listed in `conditions` and routed as PULSE Downstream Items DS-C1..DS-C10. This verdict does not claim the conditions are resolvable operationally or safe to skip — they are blocking on their owners until re-proved.
honesty_core_evidence: PRD.md carries 17 explicit NOT_CLAIMED tags; VF-F3/F4/F5 in PULSE hold the engine's behaviour, epsilon/lambda, and every CONTRACT example number at NOT_CLAIMED; forge left reviewer_model and the thesis-2 event EMPTY rather than fabricate them; LIMITATIONS.md exists at 408 lines. No leaderboard, no user counts, no analytics, no benchmark scores anywhere in the corpus.

conditions.statement: Every :FLOW edge must carry BOTH `nl` and `cap` before B2 seeds. With DERIVED_FROM collapsed into :FLOW, algo.SPpaths traverses split edges too, and a missing weight property makes pathWeight silently collapse to hop count with no error.
conditions.reproof: PULSE VF-C5 — live probe on `menger2`: pathWeight 7 == pathCost 7. The T-3b guard (pathWeight != pathCost) catches it.

conditions.statement: The DOCKET independence/reliability Cypher must use the MATCH-bound node form (ARCHITECTURE.md:6347-6352). The published form at CONTRACT.md:340/:347, PLAN.md:249-257/:273-281 and INVARIANTS.md:167-175 does not execute on falkordb v4.22.1.
conditions.reproof: PULSE VF-C3 / VF-C4 — both forms run live against gh-falkor; the published form errors, the MATCH-bound form returns.

conditions.statement: CONTRACT.md v1.1 must specify Access-Control-Allow-Headers and Access-Control-Allow-Methods. As frozen, :30 gives only Allow-Origin, so the application/json POSTs to /remember and /replay trigger a preflight the contract does not answer and every console write from :3000 fails.
conditions.reproof: Deferred to integrate at 17:30. Flagged now because it surfaces there, which is too late to amend cheaply.

conditions.statement: Three gates in this corpus are vacuous as written and certify nothing: PLAN.md:674 (ERE `\|` is a literal pipe, so the banned-word grep cannot fail), INV-3's break test (expects 0, returns 77 including its own file), and FEATURE-OBSERVABLES.md:654-655 (the `or .epsilon == null` disjunct makes an endpoint that OMITS epsilon read PASS). Re-prove by hand.
conditions.reproof: PULSE VF-C6 / VF-C9; the FEATURE-OBSERVABLES disjunct is read directly.

conditions.statement: Do not promote '41ms cold / 11ms warm' to a MENGER latency claim — it is a real measurement OF THE ENGINE's maxFlow probe, not of the HTTP surface. Do not quote the 384/267/71/17/33/18 roster dataset as a statistic: CL-F-008 means it has no retained backing artifact.
conditions.reproof: AF-7 scoping read directly; CL-F-008 is open UPSTREAM.

conditions.statement: The eight-step drill at ARCHITECTURE.md §7.14 asserts no BLOCK on any step — step 5 (THE HERO BEAT) asserts `recorded == true` / `independence == 1`, i.e. an ADMITTED write, and step 7 lands UNDECIDED. The product's headline verdict has no executable witness, PRD.md:731 S-2 is not proved by the drill, and PRD.md:553 demo beat 2 ('the graph refused it') has nothing behind it. Add a ninth step: POST a losing write into an OCCUPIED slot, assert verdict==BLOCK and status==REFUSED and recorded==true, then re-read the slot and assert the incumbent value is unchanged.
conditions.reproof: PULSE VF-C11 — `sed -n '4745,4862p' ARCHITECTURE.md | grep -n 'BLOCK\|REFUSED'` returns nothing. Surfaced by the CL-F-005 distinct-model cross-review (round 2) and re-verified by hand.

severity_note: No severity was demoted by this phase. CL-F-009 was P0 on entry and is recorded as AUDIT-COMPLETE / FIXES-OPEN — the P0 is discharged as an audit duty and its findings are re-emitted as BLOCKING conditions COND-1..COND-3, not laundered to a lower severity. Two ledger premises were corrected on evidence in BOTH directions (epsilon has no conflict — overstated; the arithmetic defect is 10+1 internal and 4 cross-document, not four — understated).

win_axes.evidence: Zero LLM anywhere in the value path; both scored inputs are graph-algorithm returns. grep for LLM|OpenAI|anthropic|gpt-|embedding finds no implementation hit.

503 BOOT_ASSERTION_FAILED; the seed refuses to run on a failed control; UNDECIDED and BLOCK are first-class verdicts; T-3's expected value is the non-integer 0.21072 specifically so a hop-count regression cannot pass.
Vertex-disjoint source independence via Menger over a node-split DAG — a theorem, asserted at boot with both controls (echo->1, independent->2).

The failed-probe second act (naive maxFlow returned 2 on the echo graph) is the most visceral asset in the project and currently appears in no judge-facing artifact. E1/E3 address it and are DEFERRED to Dami, not auto-approved.

The six-criterion mapping exists at PRD.md:640-664, a document no judge opens. Competitor ninaivu ships one in its README. E2 (mirror the rubric in the README) is auto-approved, effort=quick, risk=none.

VACUOUSLY absent, not missing: there is no AI output anywhere in the value path, so there is nothing for an advisory-law contract to govern. Scoring this STRONG would claim a guarantee the system never makes.
